name: Hong Kong

fees.name: Ordinary visa / entry permit (visit, single entry)
fees.validity: typically valid for a single visit within 3 months of issue
fees.applies: nationalities not eligible for visa-free entry (e.g. mainland CHN residents use separate schemes; visa required for ~20 nationalities)
fees.notes: Immigration Department fee table effective 08-04-2026. Same HK$330 fee applies to visit, business and student ordinary visas outside the specified talent/investment schemes.

fees.name: Ordinary visa (business visit)
fees.applies: nationalities requiring a visa for business visits
fees.notes: Business visits use the same ordinary visa fee of HK$330; no separate business-visa category.

fees.name: Transit visa
fees.applies: nationalities requiring a visa even for transit (most travellers transiting by air without leaving the airport need no visa)

fees.name: e-Visa (electronic visa/entry permit)
fees.notes: Hong Kong issues visas electronically ('e-Visa') since 2021 for online applications; the fee is the same ordinary visa/entry permit fee, no separate e-visa surcharge.

vfs.note: No outsourced visa centre. Applications are lodged online with the Immigration Department, by post, or forwarded free of charge through Chinese embassies/consulates overseas.

free_visa_notes: Nationals of about 170 countries/territories may visit Hong Kong visa-free for 7 to 180 days (e.g. GBR 180 days; USA, CAN, RUS, PHL and most others 14-90 days). Visas are only required for a small set of nationalities (incl. IND pre-arrival registration - free; NGA, PAK, BGD require visas at HK$330). No visa-on-arrival or paid eTA regime exists; India nationals instead complete a free online Pre-arrival Registration.
